documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key domestic and export markets, improved realizations, and operational efficiencies. The management noted that their 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha is progressing on schedule for commercial production in the coming months. Furthermore, they remain optimistic about the medium to long-term outlook, supported by stable raw material environments, favorable trade agreements, and strong order visibility. Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting a revenue from operations of Rs. 781.1 crores and an EBITDA margin of 19.8% for the quarter.

guidance.claim: Management expects the Odisha unit to achieve margins at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% higher than the operations once it is fully operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the current financial year and exceed INR4,000 crores next year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores. So that's what 20% up. And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 96% to 97% utilization for the Odisha plant by the start of the next financial year.
guidance.quote: Of course, that's our target that we want to reach 96%, 97% utilization by the start of the next financial year.

guidance.claim: The company gives a long-term normalized EBITDA margin guidance of around 15% once the new project comes in.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: For the upcoming quarter, management expects the performance to be similar or even better than the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: See, again, in this macro environment, we really can't comment too much going forward. But yes, the current quarter looks to be similar or even better than what we have delivered this last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue accounted for about 52% of total revenue in the last quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: So it is about 52% of our total revenue the last quarter has been through exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company currently has order visibility until March 10, with demand remaining strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good. The demand is the same or even better than what it was. So the demand outlook continues to be strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand from all markets remained healthy with positive outlooks going into the second quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, demand is expected to remain supportive in coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: The global textile and apparel sector is gradually recovering after a prolonged period of demand moderation with inventories largely normalized.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the global textile and apparel sector is gradually recovering after a prolonged period of demand moderation and a lot of consolidation has happened in last few years.

demand_outlook.claim: China has emerged as a big buyer for Indian yarn exports, driving increased demand and higher prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China. Bangladesh continues to be steady as they were. And China, we continue to see every month, we see them as a buyer.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha represents a INR1,000 crores investment.
capex_expansion.quote: So the company has announced the INR1,000 crores Greenfield expansion in Odisha involving 1.5 lakh splindles.

capex_expansion.claim: Building construction for the Odisha project is almost complete and machinery is arriving in a staggered manner.
capex_expansion.quote: Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete. The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on a lease basis.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an improvement in EBITDA margin to 19.8% in Q2 FY27 compared to 10.4% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The company reported a significant improvement in EBITDA margin to 19.8% in Q2 FY27 compared to 10.4% in Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Depreciation run rate from next quarter is expected to be around INR17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: The quarter's earnings growth was driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement.
margins_costs.quote: The quarter was particularly encouraging as the growth in earnings was driven by a combination of better yarn realizations, strong export demand and disciplined raw material procurement.

margins_costs.claim: Strategic buying enabled the company to effectively manage input costs and protect margins despite raw material price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Despite some increases in raw material prices during this period, our strategic buying approach enabled us to effectively manage input costs and protect margins.

margins_costs.claim: The newly commissioned solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The solar project is expected to generate annual cost savings of around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant features embedded incentives and subsidies that are expected to yield margins 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing manufacturing facilities operated at 99% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization of all units is more than 96%.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilisation of all units more than 96%

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days as part of its risk management policy.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The Odisha project features a 30% capital subsidy payable in 5 equal installments over 5 years on a INR1,000 crores investment.
capital_allocation.quote: First is the capital subsidy, which we are going to get for 30% capital subsidy, which will be paid to us in 5 equal installments. On a INR1,000 crores investment, we are looking at about INR200 to INR220 crores coming back to us in 5 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: China levies an import duty of 40% on raw cotton and 3% on cotton yarn.
risks_headwinds.quote: And there is an import duty of 40% on any cotton they import, and there is 3% duty on any cotton yarn they import.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production at the Odisha greenfield expansion project is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year, with the entire project finished within the year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to ramp up the large Odisha plant fully within 5 to 6 months, reaching about 90% capacity utilization by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: It's a big plant. So it will take us around 5 to 6 months to fully ramp up. And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
